data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**\. However, if you're using Shopify, I'd recommend **Shopify Payments** instead.

The best choice depends on your website platform, monthly sales, and how customers prefer to pay.

## Best payment processors compared

![Stripe Logo Download (SVG, PNG, EPS, PDF) | PixelBrands](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aVtuLxJXV9DmtEmg9b45Apl_aIYsif99dM-GHSfkXYZDC4tFOhFvFlTrHocFw_PqD4iGlfn8TyGj8Knz3iEfgQ88Gl1qbf-qVS8yq3s_dga8IuVvdS85dQWTHuxQAfDBHQSn4bvLAWea6XSgqDlmrU-sz5LlptntGZmOFqqabVil8_uydbbIqAvaqwgrj-k8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Standard US online card rate: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Great integrations with WooCommerce, Wix, and custom websites.
- Strong fraud prevention and subscription tools.

[Stripe pricing](https://stripe.com/pricing)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Basic online card rate: 2.9% + \$0.30
- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees.
- Simple order and refund management.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Great for customer familiarity and trust.
- Supports PayPal wallet payments and other checkout options.
- Often higher transaction fees.
- Good as an additional payment option.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/us/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Best if you sell online and in person.
- Online rates start around 3.3% + \$0.30 on its Free plan.
- Includes point-of-sale tools and inventory management.

[Square payments](https://squareup.com/us/en/payments)

These are standard US pricing examples; actual fees depend on payment method, plan, and transaction type. [www.nerdwallet.com](https://www.nerdwallet.com/business/software/learn/stripe-vs-paypal-vs-square?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[kitmere.com](https://kitmere.com/compare/stripe-vs-paypal-vs-square-vs-shopify-payments/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were starting a small online store today, I'd use\:

- **Stripe** for credit and debit card processing.
- **PayPal** as an additional checkout option.
- **Shopify Payments** instead of Stripe if the store runs on Shopify.

This gives customers flexibility without making payment processing unnecessarily complicated.
